rikka.menu.title: Rikka Client
rikka.menu.profiles.name: Profile name
rikka.menu.profiles.delete.title: Delete %s?
rikka.menu.profiles.delete.message: The profile and its settings are removed for good.
rikka.menu.profiles.server.invalid: Enter a host name or IP address, optionally with a port.
rikka.menu.music.empty: Drop music files here or put them in the rikka/music folder.
rikka.menu.hud.title: HUD Editor
rikka.preference.menu_key.description: The key that opens this menu in game.
rikka.preference.hud_editor_key.descript: The key that opens the HUD editor in game.
rikka.preference.music_play_key.descript: The key that plays or pauses the music in game.
rikka.preference.music_next_key.descript: The key that skips to the next song in game.
rikka.preference.music_previous_key.desc: The key that restarts the song, or goes back to the previous one near its start, in game.
rikka.preference.hud_surface.description: What shows through the panels: nothing, a blur of the game, liquid glass that also bends it, or the menu's background.
rikka.preference.hud_fill_color.descript: The panel color, with its transparency.
rikka.preference.hud_fill_opacity.descri: How solid the gradient or theme fill is.
rikka.preference.hud_outline_color.descr: The color of the line around the panels.
rikka.preference.hud_outline_width.descr: How thick the line around the panels is.
rikka.preference.hud_shadow.description: A dark shadow, or a glow in the accent gradient, around the panels.
rikka.preference.hud_shadow_size.descrip: How far the shadow or glow spreads.
rikka.preference.hud_shadow_strength.des: How strong the shadow or glow is.
rikka.preference.hud_radius.description: How round the panel corners are.
rikka.preference.hud_text.description: What colors the text and icons.
rikka.preference.hud_text_color.descript: The color of the text and icons.
rikka.preference.hud_text_shadow.descrip: Draws a dark copy beneath the text, like Minecraft's own.
rikka.preference.hud_accent.description: The two colors of the gradients.
rikka.preference.hud_accent_start.descri: The first color of your own gradient.
rikka.preference.hud_accent_end.descript: The second color of your own gradient.
rikka.preference.hud_angle.description: The direction of the gradients, in degrees clockwise from upward.
rikka.setting.bind.description: The key that turns this mod on or off.
rikka.setting.bind_mode.description: Toggle switches on each press; Hold keeps the mod on while the key is held.
rikka.setting.position.description: Where this element sits on the screen.
rikka.setting.icon.description: Shows the icon before the text.
rikka.setting.background.description: Draws the HUD style's panel behind the content.
rikka.mod.fps_display.description: Shows how many frames are drawn each second.
rikka.mod.ping_display.description: Shows the round trip to the server, measured every second; falls back to the server's own figure when it does not answer.
rikka.mod.cps_display.description: Shows your mouse clicks per second.
rikka.mod.reach_display.description: Shows the distance of your last hit the server confirmed.
rikka.mod.reach_display.setting.decimals: How many digits follow the decimal point.
rikka.mod.combo_counter.description: Counts your hits in a row until you are hit or stop hitting.
rikka.mod.speedometer.description: Shows how fast you or your vehicle move.
rikka.mod.speedometer.setting.unit.descr: The unit the speed is shown in.
rikka.mod.speedometer.setting.vertical.d: Counts climbing and falling as well as horizontal movement.
rikka.mod.jump_reset_indicator.descripti: Shows how well your jump was timed against the last hit you took.
rikka.mod.jump_reset_indicator.setting.w: How many ticks apart a jump and a hit may be to count.
rikka.mod.coords.setting.direction.descr: Shows the compass direction you face.
rikka.mod.clock.setting.hour_cycle.descr: Whether hours run to 24 or to 12 with AM and PM.
rikka.mod.day_counter.description: Shows how many days have passed in the world.
rikka.mod.weather_display.description: Shows the weather where you stand.
rikka.mod.player_counter.description: Shows how many players are on the server or nearby.
rikka.mod.player_counter.setting.scope.d: Counts everyone in the player list, or only players loaded around you.
rikka.mod.server_address.description: Shows the address of the server you play on.
rikka.mod.stopwatch.description: A stopwatch you start, stop and reset with keys.
rikka.mod.stopwatch.setting.start_stop.d: Starts the stopwatch, or stops it where it is.
rikka.mod.stopwatch.setting.reset.descri: Stops the stopwatch and sets it back to zero.
rikka.mod.memory_usage.description: Shows how much of the game's memory is in use.
rikka.mod.memory_usage.setting.format.de: Shows a percentage or the amount used of the maximum.
rikka.mod.old_animations.description: Brings back the 1.7 animations: sword blocking, item poses, sneaking, hearts and hit tint. Visual only; nothing is sent to the server.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.sword_b: Holding right click raises the sword in the 1.7 blocking pose. Cosmetic only; no damage is blocked.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.blockin: The items that raise into the blocking pose.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.block_h: Plays the swing on top of the blocking pose.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.third_p: How a blocking sword looks in third person.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.first_p: Places held items, eating, drinking and bow drawing exactly like 1.7.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.third_p: Holds tools, rods, bows and other items in the 1.7 position on players.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.swing_w: Keeps the arm swing going while eating, drinking or drawing a bow.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.punch_b: Swings and shows hit particles when you hold attack at a block you are not breaking, such as while using an item. Visual only.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.sneak_c: Drops the camera the instant you sneak, as in 1.7. Aiming still starts from the real eye position.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.sneak_d: How far the camera drops while sneaking, in blocks. 1.7 dropped 0.08; modern drops 0.35.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.sneak_e: Lets the camera rise over a few ticks when you stop sneaking, as in 1.7.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.sneak_p: Draws sneaking players with the 1.7 body pose.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.heart_f: Flashes the hearts you lose or regain. Off restores the calm 1.7 health bar.
rikka.mod.old_animations.setting.armor_h: Turns worn armor red together with the wearer when hurt.
rikka.setting.perspective.description: The third-person view the camera swings to.
rikka.mod.force_main_hand.description: Draws every other player holding items in the hand you pick. Visual only; their real main hand and your own are untouched.
rikka.mod.force_main_hand.setting.hand.d: The hand other players are drawn holding their items in.
rikka.mod.fullbright.description: Lights the whole world, in caves and at night alike. Visual only.
rikka.mod.fullbright.setting.gamma.descr: How strongly the world is brightened. Higher values light darker places.
rikka.mod.particles.description: Adds extra critical-hit and sharpness sparkles to hits. Visual only.
rikka.mod.particles.setting.criticals.de: When to add extra critical-hit sparkles. Natural multiplies the ones the server shows for real critical hits; Always adds them to every hit you land.
rikka.mod.particles.setting.criticals_am: How many extra bursts each critical hit gets.
rikka.mod.particles.setting.sharpness.de: When to add extra enchantment sparkles. Natural multiplies the ones the server shows for hits with damage enchantments; Always adds them to every hit you land.
rikka.mod.particles.setting.sharpness_am: How many extra bursts each enchanted hit gets.
rikka.mod.blood_particle.description: Sprays blood from every living target you hit, once the server confirms the damage. Visual only.
How many bursts of blood each hit sprays.
rikka.mod.blood_particle.setting.sound.d: Plays a squelch where the target was hit.
rikka.mod.projectile_trail.description: Leaves a trail of particles behind flying projectiles. Visual only.
rikka.mod.projectile_trail.setting.effec: The particle the trail is made of.
rikka.mod.projectile_trail.setting.own_o: Leaves trails behind your own projectiles only.
rikka.mod.free_look.description: Look around freely while your body keeps facing and moving the way it was. From first person the camera swings out to a third-person view and returns when you stop. Hold the key, or switch to Toggle in its controls.
rikka.mod.free_look.setting.limit_yaw.de: Stops the camera from turning further than a set angle away from where your body faces.
rikka.mod.free_look.setting.max_yaw.desc: How far, in degrees, the camera may turn to either side.
rikka.mod.tap_look.description: Glance at yourself by holding a key: the camera swings to a third-person view and returns when you let go. Switch to Toggle in its controls to flip it on each press.
rikka.mod.zoom.description: Zooms in while you hold the key and eases back when you let go. Scroll while zooming to change the magnification.
rikka.mod.zoom.setting.factor.descriptio: How many times closer the view gets when zooming starts.
rikka.mod.zoom.setting.scroll.descriptio: Uses the scroll wheel to change the magnification while zooming instead of switching hotbar slots.
rikka.mod.zoom.setting.scale_sensitivity: Slows mouse look in step with the zoom so aiming covers the same part of the screen.
rikka.mod.zoom.setting.smooth.descriptio: Glides in and out of the zoom instead of jumping.
rikka.mod.zoom.setting.speed.description: How quickly the zoom settles. Higher is snappier.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.description: Translates chat with Google Translate. Click [✎] after a message to show its translation underneath, or turn on Translate on Send in the chat screen to send your messages in another language.
The language messages you receive are translated into.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.setting.auto_tr: Translates every incoming message that is not already in your language as soon as it arrives.
Adds a [✎] button after each message that shows or hides its translation.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.setting.server_: Also translates messages from the server, not only what players say.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.setting.outgoin: Translates what you type before sending it, including the text of /msg, /tell, /w, /r, /me and /teammsg. Also switched from the chat screen.
The language your messages are translated into before they are sent.
The languages the chat screen's language button steps through: left click for the next, right click or scroll back for the previous.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.bar.outgoing.to: Translates what you send into the language beside this button.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.bar.language.to: Left click: next language. Right click or scroll: previous. Pick the languages under Quick Switch Languages.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.error.timeout: Google Translate did not answer in time.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.error.rate_limi: Too many translations; try again in a minute.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.error.malformed: Google Translate gave an unreadable answer.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.error.key_unava: Could not get access to Google Translate.
rikka.mod.chat_translate.error.too_long: The translation is longer than 256 characters.
rikka.mod.hit_delay_fix.description: Removes the ten-tick wait after swinging at nothing that swallows your next clicks.
rikka.mod.no_jump_delay.description: Removes the ten-tick wait between jumps, so holding jump bounces you the moment you land.
rikka.mod.snap_tap.description: When both keys of a pair (left and right, forward and back) are held, the one pressed last wins, and the other takes over again when it is released.
rikka.mod.time_changer.description: Shows the sky at a time of day you choose. Only your view changes; the world keeps its own time.
rikka.mod.time_changer.setting.mode.desc: Fixed holds the hour you pick; Real Time follows your computer's clock.
rikka.mod.time_changer.setting.time.desc: The hour of the day to show, from 0 (midnight) to 24. 6 is sunrise, 12 is noon and 18 is sunset.
rikka.mod.weather_changer.description: Shows the weather you pick, in any biome. Only your view changes; the server keeps its own weather.
rikka.mod.weather_changer.setting.weathe: The weather to show. Rain and snow fall everywhere, including deserts and snowy plains.
rikka.mod.weather_changer.setting.rain_i: How hard it rains. Rain and sky darkening, fog and the sound of rain follow it. Thunderstorms rain at this intensity too.
rikka.mod.weather_changer.setting.snow_i: How hard it snows. Sky darkening and fog follow it.
rikka.mod.weather_changer.setting.thunde: How dark the thunderstorm sky gets, on top of the rain intensity.
rikka.mod.weather_changer.setting.lightn: Strikes lightning in the distance during a thunderstorm, with flashes and thunder. These strikes are only visual and never start fires or hurt anything.
Strikes per minute at full thunder intensity.
rikka.mod.motion_blur.description: Blurs motion the way your eyes do, so turns and movement look fluid instead of stuttering. Looks best with the frame rate capped to your monitor's refresh rate.
rikka.mod.motion_blur.setting.strength.d: How long the blur trails. 1.0 blurs across exactly one frame of your monitor.
Velocity blurs each pixel along its motion and adds no input lag. Frame Blending mixes recent frames like a video editor. Hybrid runs both for the smoothest result at a higher cost. Accumulation Max leaves bright trails; Accumulation Mix leaves even ones.
rikka.mod.motion_blur.setting.profile.de: Uniform is a classic even blur; Weighted fades the trail out for smoother transitions but looks slightly softer.
rikka.mod.motion_blur.setting.refresh_ra: Lengthens the blur while your frame rate is above your monitor's refresh rate, hiding the frames it cannot show. At 600 FPS on a 60 Hz monitor the blur is ten times longer.
rikka.mod.crosshair.description: Replaces the crosshair with one you design: shape, size, gap, color, outline and a spread that reacts to movement, bows and attack cooldown.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.style.descri: The shape of the crosshair. Vanilla keeps the game's own.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.blend.descri: Normal draws in your color; Invert flips the colors behind it like the vanilla crosshair, so it stays visible everywhere.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.length.descr: How long each arm is, in GUI pixels.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.thickness.de: How thick the lines are, in GUI pixels.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.gap.descript: The empty space around the center, in GUI pixels.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.dot.descript: Adds a dot in the middle.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.outline.desc: Draws a border around the crosshair so it stands out on bright and dark backgrounds.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.outline_thic: How thick the border is, in GUI pixels.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.dynamic.desc: Opens the gap while you move, jump or wait for your attack to recharge, and closes it as you draw a bow or crossbow.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.dynamic_spre: How far the gap opens at most, in GUI pixels.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.highlight.de: Changes color while you aim at a living creature.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.highlight_co: The color while aiming at a living creature.
rikka.mod.crosshair.setting.third_person: Keeps the crosshair on screen in third-person views.
rikka.mod.hit_color.description: Changes the color creatures flash when they are hurt.
rikka.mod.hit_color.setting.color.descri: The flash color. Its opacity sets how strongly hurt creatures are tinted.
rikka.mod.target_indicator.description: Draws a glowing ring that sweeps up and down around the creature you are fighting.
rikka.mod.target_indicator.setting.speed: How quickly the ring sweeps up and down.
rikka.mod.target_indicator.setting.radiu: How wide the ring is compared to the creature.
rikka.mod.item_physics.description: Dropped items tumble as they fall and come to rest lying flat on the ground instead of floating and spinning. Turns off 2D Items.
rikka.mod.item_physics.setting.speed.des: How fast items turn over while falling.
rikka.mod.items_2d.description: Dropped flat items always face you like sprites instead of spinning. Blocks stay 3D. Turns off Item Physics.
rikka.mod.minimap.description: A map of the land around you, shaded by height, with nearby players and creatures. Switches to a cave view underground and in the Nether.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.shape.descript: The outline of the map: a 16:9 widescreen rectangle, a square or a circle. Size sets its width.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.rotate.descrip: Turns the map so the way you face is always up. When off, north stays up and the arrow turns instead.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.zoom.descripti: How many map pixels each block takes. Higher shows less land in more detail.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.zoom_in.descri: The key that doubles the zoom.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.zoom_out.descr: The key that halves the zoom.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.layer.descript: Surface maps the ground seen from the sky; Caves maps the floor at your height; Auto switches to Caves underground and in the Nether.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.colors.descrip: Blocks colors the land from its textures and biome tints; Map uses the flat palette of vanilla maps.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.opacity.descri: How solid the map is drawn.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.players.descri: Shows other players as their heads.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.animals.descri: Shows animals and other peaceful creatures as green dots.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.cursor.descrip: Shows the arrow at the center of the map that marks your position and heading.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.cardinals.desc: Marks north, east, south and west around the edge.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.coordinates.de: Shows your block position under the map.
rikka.mod.minimap.setting.background.des: Draws a glass frame behind the map, visible where the land is not yet known.
rikka.mod.rearview.description: A 16:9 window showing what is behind you, drawn from your eyes looking back, with players, creatures, particles, clouds and weather.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.fov.descripti: How wide the view behind you is, in degrees from top to bottom.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.frame_rate.de: How many times per second the view is redrawn at most. Lower costs fewer frames per second.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.render_distan: How many chunks away the view reaches, fading into fog at the edge. Never farther than your game's render distance. Lower costs fewer frames per second.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.resolution.de: How many pixels the view is drawn with for each screen pixel it covers. Above 1.0 smooths jagged edges; below 1.0 costs less.
Tilts the view up and down with your head. When off, it stays level with the horizon.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.mirror.descri: Flips the view left to right like a car mirror, so what is behind your left shoulder shows on the left.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.opacity.descr: How solid the view is drawn.
rikka.mod.rearview.setting.background.de: Draws a glass frame around the view.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.description: Shows your movement keys, jump and mouse buttons lighting up as you press them, with clicks per second.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.labels.desc: Writes the bound key on each key.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.space.descr: Adds a wide key for jump.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.mouse.descr: Adds the left and right mouse buttons.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.cps.descrip: Shows how many times each mouse button was clicked in the last second.
Draws a glass panel behind each key.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.pressed_col: The color a key fills with while held.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.pressed_tex: The color of the key names while held.
rikka.mod.keystrokes.setting.fade_time.d: How long, in milliseconds, a key takes to light up and fade back.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.description: A dot that follows your mouse movements and drifts back to the center.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.setting.sensitiv: How far the dot moves for the same mouse movement.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.setting.trail.de: Leaves a fading trail behind the dot.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.setting.trail_le: How many past positions the trail keeps.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.setting.crosshai: Draws faint lines through the center.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.setting.backgrou: Draws a glass panel behind the dot.
rikka.mod.mouse_strokes.setting.dot_colo: The color of the dot and its trail.
rikka.mod.inventory_display.description: Shows the 27 storage slots of your inventory, with counts and durability.
rikka.mod.inventory_display.setting.titl: Shows a heading above the slots.
rikka.mod.inventory_display.setting.back: Draws a glass panel behind the slots.
rikka.mod.inventory_display.setting.slot: Marks each slot, including empty ones.
rikka.mod.inventory_display.title: Inventory
rikka.mod.pack_display.description: Shows the resource pack you are using, with its icon.
rikka.mod.pack_display.setting.all.descr: Lists every enabled pack from top to bottom instead of only the top one.
rikka.mod.pack_display.setting.descripti: Shows the first line of each pack's description.
rikka.mod.pack_display.setting.backgroun: Draws a glass panel behind the list.
rikka.mod.target_info.description: Shows the creature you are fighting or aiming at: its face, name, health, armor and distance.
rikka.mod.target_info.setting.background: Draws a glass panel behind the card.
rikka.mod.target_info.setting.portrait.d: Shows the player's face, or a small model for other creatures.
rikka.mod.target_info.setting.distance.d: Shows how far away the target is.
rikka.mod.target_info.setting.dynamic_co: Colors the health bar from green to red as health drops.
The color of the health bar.
rikka.mod.music_info.description: Shows the song the music player is playing, with its cover and progress.
rikka.mod.music_info.setting.progress.de: Shows how far the song has played.
Draws a glass panel behind the song.
